Hastings Sunrise is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. From November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 73 homes sold there: 40 houses, 4 condos, 3 townhomes and 26 duplexes. 40 houses sold in Hastings Sunrise with a median price of $1,604,000 (the middle half sold between $1,447,250 and $1,917,000), taking a median of 15 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 10% sold above list.
Hastings Sunrise home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

40 houses sold in Hastings Sunrise with a median price of $1,604,000 (the middle half sold between $1,447,250 and $1,917,000), taking a median of 15 days to sell at 97.1% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $726 per square foot, a median year built of 1946 and a median lot of 4,026 square feet. 26 duplexes sold in Hastings Sunrise with a median price of $1,492,000 (the middle half sold between $1,392,500 and $1,545,500), taking a median of 40 days to sell at 97.0% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $955 per square foot and a median year built of 2025.

items.t: Hastings-Sunrise is one of the City of Vancouver's 22 local planning areas, covering 8.0 km2 and about 7% of the city's land area.

Hastings Park (PNE, Playland, the Sanctuary) sits at the northeast corner of the city between McGill Street, Hastings Street, Renfrew Street and the Cassiar Connector; the master plan places the Hastings-Sunrise community to its west and south.

The R1-1 zone replaced all former RS zones from October 17, 2023. It allows single detached houses with a suite or laneway house, duplexes, character retention, and multiplexes of 3 to 6 strata units or up to 8 rental units.
Council approved the Vancouver Official Development Plan on March 12, 2026; it does not rezone any property itself.
The City's 2016 census profile showed about 41% of households renting, against 53% citywide.

blocks.text: Hastings Sunrise: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Hastings Community Centre is listed at 3096 E Hastings.
It faces the PNE and Hastings Park and has a gym, fitness centre, racquetball court, tennis court, playground and water park; it is associated with Templeton Park Pool.
Hastings Community Elementary, 2625 Franklin Street, offers K-7 English and French Immersion; Tillicum Annex serves K-4 in English; the school is in the Templeton Secondary family.
Templeton Secondary School is at 727 Templeton Drive.
The VSB pages link a catchment locator and state no boundaries; confirm catchment there.
Routes R5, 14 and 16 run on Hastings Street between the Iron Workers Memorial Bridge and Boundary Road.
Bus stop changes are expected in late 2026; proposed bus lanes are on hold, with Renfrew Street to Boundary Road to be reviewed in a corridor study planned for 2027.

faq.q: What did homes in Hastings Sunrise sell for?
faq.a: 40 houses sold in Hastings Sunrise between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,604,000.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Hastings Sunrise?
faq.a: The median was 15 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 97.1% of the last list price (10% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Hastings Sunrise sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 40 houses that sold in Hastings Sunrise went for between $1,447,250 and $1,917,000, around a median of $1,604,000.

faq.q: Do houses in Hastings Sunrise sell above asking price?
faq.a: 10% of the 40 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 97.1% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Hastings Sunrise?
faq.a: The median year built was 1946 for the 40 houses sold in Hastings Sunrise.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Hastings Sunrise usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Hastings Sunrise had 4 bedrooms, from the 40 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
